name: 香槟金圆润静音加湿器款
description: 细腻出雾、静音卧室加湿、简约圆润机身的加湿器套图模版

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft sage green #C5DCBB panels for benefit and CTA shots, warm greige #F3EFE9 for infographic screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft fill, soft contact shadows, gentle diffused mist rendering, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white countertop and light wood or warm greige #F3EFE9 surfaces
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type with short labels in charcoal #3B4045; champagne-gold #C9A26B reserved for thin-line icons and one accent element per screen
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single champagne-gold #C9A26B accent
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the product across the set, centered and grounded with soft contact shadow; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh minimalist home-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft sage green #C5DCBB, warm greige #F3EFE9 and charcoal text #3B4045, with one champagne-gold accent #C9A26B used only for thin-line icons and one accent element per screen; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft fill, soft contact shadows and gentle diffused mist rendering; modern geometric sans-serif headline type; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable centered product presentation with soft contact shadow; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight 3/4 angle, product upright and fully visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, a compact rounded countertop humidifier-style appliance. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view at a slight 3/4 angle, full product visible, upright and stable, filling 60-70% of the frame so the composition reads complete and balanced. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

shots.intent: 一秒传达细腻出雾的核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, product on the lower right
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle diffused mist, soft contact shadow
shots.background: soft sage green panel #C5DCBB over clean white #FFFFFF
shots.textZone: right side one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #3B4045 with one thin-line icon in #C9A26B beside it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} with a soft visible mist plume rising from the top outlet. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle on the lower right, filling 50-60% of the frame. Soft sage green panel #C5DCBB over a clean white #FFFFFF background, soft front-left key light, gentle diffused mist, soft contact shadow. The right side carries one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #3B4045 with one thin-line icon in #C9A26B beside it, completing one balanced composition. Negative: no more than one claim, no invented performance numbers, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 代入睡前卧室使用场景，强化静音舒适联想
shots.camera: eye-level candid shot from a low-side angle, handheld feel
shots.lighting: warm 3000K bedside lamp glow from the right mixed with soft cool ambient light, soft shadows
shots.background: cozy dim bedroom with warm greige #F3EFE9 bedding tones in soft focus
shots.props: a folded blanket and a small book on the bedside table, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} quietly humidifying on a bedside table in a cozy dim bedroom at night, a gentle mist plume rising, the product anchoring the frame and filling 40-50% of it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level candid shot from a low-side angle with a handheld feel. Warm 3000K bedside lamp glow from the right mixed with soft cool ambient light, soft shadows, consistent light direction. Warm greige #F3EFE9 bedding and headboard tones in soft focus. Props: a folded blanket and a small book, not covering the product. Negative: no visible face, no hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered scene, no contradictory light directions.

shots.intent: 用雾化瞬间微距证明细腻出雾的产品力
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, shallow depth of field, mist foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the left revealing translucent mist texture, controlled highlight
shots.background: soft white #FFFFFF fading into pale sage green #C5DCBB
shots.whitespace: minimal, the mist is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the fine cool mist plume jetting from the top nozzle of {product}, tight zoom on the atomized droplets. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, shallow depth of field with the mist foreground sharp. Raking side light from the left revealing the translucent mist texture, controlled highlight. Soft white #FFFFFF background fading into pale sage green #C5DCBB. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only minimal margins around it, because the mist itself is the whole point of the frame. Negative: no blurry subject, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated product parts, no over-smoothed plastic surfaces.

shots.intent: 展示水箱开口加香薰的用法，拓展使用联想

shots.lighting: soft diffused top light, drop and water surface sharp, soft shadows
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF countertop with a pale sage green #C5DCBB mat
shots.props: one unbranded dropper bottle held by a generic hand
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle: a generic hand releasing a single drop of essential oil into the open water tank of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field, the drop and water surface sharp, the tank opening and drop filling 55-60% of the frame. Soft diffused top light, soft shadows. Clean white #FFFFFF countertop with a pale sage green #C5DCBB mat. One short label 「{selling_point_2}」 in #3B4045 sits at the lower left, completing the layout. Negative: no brand bottle labels, no garbled text, no watermark, no fake logo, no deformed hands or fused fingers.

shots.intent: 用尺寸线稿直观呈现机身规格，消除买前疑虑，不发明数据

shots.intent: 用滤芯结构与静音机身的真实细节降风险，保障点图文直接呈现，不虚构认证

Straight-on front view of the product centered and filling 50-60% of the frame, its rounded matte silhouette and seam lines rendered in clean tactile detail. Two slim rounded trust labels in one row beside the product reading 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」 in #3B4045, each with a small thin-line icon in champagne-gold #C9A26B, so the row reads as a finished integrated band. shots.intent: 低角度气势收口，暗示组合购买并用醒目按钮引导下单

shots.lighting: even soft studio light with a gentle champagne-gold #C9A26B rim accent, soft contact shadows

shots.props: one rounded CTA button in champagne-gold #C9A26B

provenance.notes: 源长图仅 4 张加湿器爆款详情切片（panel-01 至 panel-04），覆盖白底/卖点主图、功能文案屏、香薰与静音场景；shot-04 喷雾雾化微距、shot-06 规格信息图、shot-07 信任屏、shot-08 CTA 收口为按环境电器行业惯例补全的 4 个版式板块，按内容板块口径合计记 8。已剥离源品牌名与型号、模特面部与身份、原文案、会员促销贴片与二维码；源图 3.0L 容量数字未保留，容量/功率/噪音等数值一律改为 {callout} 或 {selling_point} 文案槽位由使用方填写，不发明任何认证与检测数据；产品统一以 {product} 占位。
